targets.name: FiveM · GTA V RP
targets.what: A resource for your own FiveM server (Cfx.re): scripts, jobs, UIs, addon clothing and jewelry streams.
targets.drop: Put the folder in resources/, add "ensure <name>" to server.cfg, restart (or refresh + ensure in txAdmin).

targets.name: RedM · RDR2 RP
targets.what: A resource for your own RedM server: the same as FiveM, for Red Dead.
targets.drop: Put the folder in resources/, add "ensure <name>" to server.cfg, restart.

targets.name: GTA SA · PS Vita port
targets.what: Mods for the GTA San Andreas Vita port (gtasa_vita): handling, cars, weather, weapons, text. Uses your own copy of the game.
targets.drop: Copy the ux0/ folder in this zip to the root of your Vita (VitaShell over USB or FTP), keeping the paths. Back up every file it replaces first.

targets.name: PS Vita homebrew
targets.what: Your own Vita game or app in C with VitaSDK. Build the .vpk on your computer, test in Vita3K, then on your own Vita.
targets.drop: Unzip, install VitaSDK, run "cmake -B build && cmake --build build" to get the .vpk, boot it in Vita3K, then install with VitaShell.

targets.name: Steam Deck
targets.what: Make a PC game feel right on Steam Deck: controls, launch options, a 1280x800 layout.
targets.drop: Follow INSTALL.md on the Deck in Desktop Mode.

targets.name: Web game
targets.what: A game that runs in any browser, phones too. It plays right here before you download it.
targets.drop: Open index.html, or put the folder on any static host.

files.fxmanifest.lua:
fx_version 'cerulean'
game 'gta5'
lua54 'yes'

author 'FEELESS Game Lab'
description 'A custom iced-out chain on the accessories slot'
version '1.0.0'

shared_script 'config.lua'
client_script 'client.lua'
server_script 'server.lua'
files.client.lua:
-- ice_chain: client side. Runs on each player's game.
RegisterCommand('ice_chain', function()
    TriggerServerEvent('ice_chain:hello')
end, false)

RegisterNetEvent('ice_chain:say', function(text)
    print(('[ice_chain] %s'):format(text))
end)
files.server.lua:
-- ice_chain: server side. Never trust the client: check every value it sends.
RegisterNetEvent('ice_chain:hello', function()
    local src = source
    TriggerClientEvent('ice_chain:say', src, ('Hello, %s'):format(GetPlayerName(src)))
end)
files.INSTALL.md:
# ice_chain

Put the ice_chain folder in resources/, add 'ensure ice_chain' to server.cfg, then restart the server (or 'refresh' then 'ensure ice_chain' in txAdmin).

steps.do: Start from the 3D studio rope chain and add the pendant
Export to Blender, convert with Sollumz to .ydd + .ytd
Manifest loads the stream folder and the meta
Add the shop meta for slot 7
ensure ice_chain, open the clothing menu, check every drawable

plan.ask: An iced-out custom chain for my server

chat.text: An addon jewelry resource for a custom iced-out chain
Wrote the manifest, config, client and server, and the install steps.

platforms.name: GTA V RP · FiveM
platforms.what: Roleplay servers for GTA V on Cfx.re (owned by Rockstar since 2023)
steps: Rent or host a server and set up txAdmin
Pick one framework (Qbox, QBCore or ESX) and stay on it
Add each resource with its own fxmanifest.lua
Wire the database through oxmysql
Test every resource alone, then together, with resmon open
Keep frame time under 0.5 ms a resource
Read the Cfx.re rules before you sell anything

platforms.name: Red Dead RP · RedM
platforms.what: Roleplay servers for Red Dead Redemption 2 on Cfx.re
steps: Host a RedM server with txAdmin
Pick VORP or RSG
Every fxmanifest needs the rdr3_warning line
Port GTA scripts by swapping natives, not copying them
Test on a clean profile

platforms.name: PS Vita homebrew
platforms.what: Your own games and apps on a Vita you own, tested in the Vita3K emulator first
steps: Install VitaSDK (CMake toolchain)
Build a VPK from your own code
Boot it in Vita3K first and log frame rate
Keep it under the Vita's memory (512 MB RAM)
Install on your own console only, where homebrew is legal
No commercial games: no dumps, no piracy

platforms.name: Steam Deck
platforms.what: PC games on SteamOS and Proton
steps: Run it under Proton and note the version
Set a 1280x800 default
Map every action in Steam Input
Hold 40 fps or better on battery
Check text size from arm's length

platforms.name: Web (WebGL)
platforms.what: Games that run in any browser
steps: Export a web build
Keep the first load under 20 MB
Touch controls for phones
Hold 60 fps on a mid phone
Save to the browser, never lose progress
